name: @hydranium/example-order-flow-vscode-servers
description: Servers-only VS Code extension for the order-flow example: hosts the language server and publishes both socket-head ports as host commands, with no UI contributions. Sideloaded by the Theia app so it can launch the server without also inheriting the VS Code shell's diagram editor.

order-flow.log.level.description: Log level for the Order Flow language server, applied live. Messages below this level are not written to the output channel.

order-flow.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between the editor and the Order Flow language server.

//activationEvents: `onStartupFinished` rather than `onLanguage:*`, because a Theia backend connection handler may poll a port command before any order-flow document is opened — the diagram or properties view can be the first thing a user touches. Waiting for `onLanguage` would leave those polls unanswered until an editor happened to open.
//contributes: No `commands` and no `customEditors`, both deliberate. The two port commands are registered at RUNTIME only (see language-client.ts): registering is sufficient to invoke a command programmatically, and contributing them would put diagnostics-only entries in a product's command palette. No custom editor is the whole reason this package exists — see the extension.ts header. `languages` and `grammars` ARE duplicated from `order-flow-vscode`, because each extension must be self-sufficient in whichever host installs it; only the runtime launch is shared.
